title: The effect of vitamin E and vitamin C in patients with COVID-19 pneumonia; a randomized controlled clinical trial
abstract: Hospitalized non-severe COVID-19 patients received vitamins C and E plus standard treatment or standard treatment alone. The primary outcome was clinical response; duration of hospitalization was also assessed.

title: Efficacy of High Dose Vitamin C, Melatonin and Zinc in Iranian Patients with Acute Respiratory Syndrome due to Coronavirus Infection: A Pilot Randomized Trial
abstract: Pilot randomized trial of standard care versus standard care plus intravenous vitamin C, oral melatonin and oral zinc. Patients were monitored for hypoxemia and inflammatory markers. ICU length of stay was reported.
